name: business-ops-platform
description: Business operations SaaS platform for small and medium-sized businesses.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names shared,api,web --prefix-colors gray,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @app/shared" "npm run dev -w @app/api" "npm run dev -w @app/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run build -w @app/api && npm run build -w @app/web
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run db:generate -w @app/api
